name: Major Otto
source:
27 years old. Called the most dangerous man in European Star Cluster. How he is dangerous is a mystery. Left Dokutsu with Muccilini and was enchanted by her. Treasures the memory of being asked to wash her panties, though he has refused.

"I am Otto. They call me "the most dangerous man in Europe". Unlucky you".
